candidates.name: LatentMAS
candidates.venue_evidence: OpenReview API2 exact note syG9I9ofd8 has venue ICML 2026 spotlight and venueid ICML.cc/2026/Conference.
candidates.repository_evidence: The accepted OpenReview note links this repository through link_to_code.
candidates.algorithm_core: Planner, Critic and Refiner generate autoregressive latent embeddings. The same frozen model passes its cache to the next agent. Judger emits the final textual answer. An embedding-weight linear system aligns hidden vectors with the input embedding space without fitting task data.

entrypoints.interface: CLI restricts model_name to Qwen3-4B or Qwen3-14B and tasks to its declared benchmarks.
List of items with question, gold and solution. Gold/solution are used in the returned evaluation records, not in question prompts.
Batched token IDs and attention mask, positive latent_steps and previous model cache.

task_fit.mcq: Supports original GPQA, ARC and MedQA prompts. Our MedXpertQA, SuperGPQA and AQuA require an explicit task formatter and output parser preserving all options.
task_fit.bright: No original retrieval or document-collection interface. Applying the method per candidate relevance decision would be a declared adaptation rather than the original end-to-end retrieval method.

training.alignment: Computed from the same frozen input/output embedding matrices. Not estimated from evaluation labels.

requirements: Remove only the CLI model-name restriction and select the actual Qwen3.5 text-model interface.
Preserve the original latent realignment and autoregressive hidden-state computation.
Replace legacy-tuple cache transport with a Qwen3.5 hybrid-cache adapter that preserves attention keys/values and recurrent states.
Do not use legacy token slicing to pretend recurrent state can be truncated. A compatible full-memory mode must be declared.
Carry per-sample historical attention masks instead of marking previous padding tokens as valid.
Set positive latent_steps explicitly. The official CLI default is zero.
Select one shared-model Transformers execution path. The vLLM plus secondary HF path loads an additional model copy and has a different memory budget.
Keep the final decoding policy and root batch size matched across methods.

implementation_observations.finding: _past_length indexes past_key_values[0][0], assuming a legacy attention cache.
_truncate_past converts Cache to and from legacy tuples and slices tensors by sequence dimension.
Alignment solves (W_out.T W_out + 1e-5 I) A = W_out.T W_in in float32.
Imports vLLM SamplingParams even for the Transformers path.

candidates.integration_decision: Strongest communication-efficiency comparator. Retain actual core, but qualify a faithful Qwen3.5 cache and model adapter before any experiment. No implementation or quality equivalence is claimed here.

candidates.name: DyFlow
candidates.venue_evidence: Official NeurIPS 2025 proceedings article and DOI10.52202/085713-5793. OpenReview exact note0pbUfmwNTy independently identifies NeurIPS 2025 poster.
candidates.repository_evidence: The accepted paper and official arXiv abstract link this repository.
candidates.algorithm_core: A designer emits a stage with generated operators, descriptions, input keys, output keys and context-dependent parameters. Operators update an explicit state. The designer replans from intermediate outputs until termination.

entrypoints.interface: Construct WorkflowExecutor with problem_description and designer/executor ModelService objects.
Runs generated stages, preserving state and returning the generated final answer.
Consumes State and generated operator parameters, invokes real language-model or code-test operations.
generate(prompt, temperature, max_tokens, msg) returns response text and usage.

task_fit.mcq: Official PubMedQA and MATH adapters provide the closest source interfaces. MedXpertQA, SuperGPQA and AQuA can use the original problem_description interface with their complete state and choices.
task_fit.bright: Original release has no retrieval-collection operator. A document access tool and ranking contract would be a declared task-interface extension, not an unchanged benchmark.

training.llm_weights: Can remain frozen when both services point to the same Qwen3.5-4B endpoint.
training.extra_learned_checkpoint: Optional DyPlanner is separately trained. The official quick-start also uses an ordinary GPT-4.1 designer, so DyPlanner is not intrinsic to the basic dynamic workflow path.
training.checkpoint_policy: No DyPlanner weights downloaded. A same-model Qwen designer must not be reported as the published DyPlanner checkpoint.

requirements: Inject a shared-model generation transport into both original service interfaces.
Make the same greedy decoding, token budgets and root batching explicit. The original designer uses temperature0.1 and self-consistency can request temperature0.7.
Record actual designer, executor, ensemble and selector calls within the shared budget.
Disable model-requested TEST_CODE in a declared text-only task protocol, or connect it to the existing isolated evaluation environment. Never execute generated code in the host process.
Keep real stage creation, state updates and feedback-driven replanning. Do not replace the core with a fixed parallel map.
Treat exhausted stages, parse failures and missing final answers as failures.

implementation_observations.finding: Actual execute loop has a maximum of eight stages.
Operators inside a stage are executed sequentially in the released core.
TEST_CODE ultimately calls exec(code, global_namespace). Its import-string filter does not enforce a filesystem boundary.
SELF_CONSISTENCY_ENSEMBLE performs real multiple generations and a selector call.

candidates.integration_decision: Best near-term source reuse for generated workflow construction. Use the actual original executor and an explicit shared-model transport and text-only operator protocol. Preserve its sequential scheduling unless a separate scheduling ablation is declared.

candidates.name: AgentPrune
candidates.venue_evidence: Official ICLR 2025 proceedings article and its BibTeX export.
candidates.repository_evidence: Official proceedings abstract and paper link the source repository.
candidates.algorithm_core: Learn Bernoulli spatial and temporal communication-edge logits with a task-reward policy-gradient objective. Periodically remove low-logit edges and execute the resulting communication graph.

entrypoints.interface: Constructs Graph, optimizes it on MMLU dev when optimized flags are enabled, and evaluates the learned graph.
Requires task records, ground-truth answers, postprocess_answer, record_to_input and record_to_target_answer.
Input dictionary and number of communication rounds, returns final answers and sampled-graph log probability.
Prunes spatial and temporal edges according to learned logits and pruning rate.

task_fit.mcq: Original MMLU adapter and prompts assume exactly four choices. Our four-to-ten-choice tasks require an explicit option-preserving prompt adapter.
task_fit.bright: No original retrieval worker interface. Learning a document-worker graph is a new task-specific training protocol, not an available frozen inference configuration.

training.llm_weights: May remain frozen behind API calls.
training.objective: Mean of -graph_log_probability * exact-answer accuracy over original examples.
training.checkpoint_evidence: Pinned repository tree contains no published .pt, .pth or .safetensors topology checkpoint.

requirements: Use the actual graph optimizer on a disjoint development set or obtain a matching graph checkpoint.
Account separately for graph-optimization calls and supervised labels.
Use an original LLM-registry transport adapter for the frozen Qwen model.
Preserve original stochastic edge sampling and pruning semantics.
Do not call a hand-set sparse graph or disabled-optimization dense graph AgentPrune.

implementation_observations.finding: Adam trains spatial_logits and temporal_logits using labeled answer accuracy.
update_masks removes edges selected from learned logits.
Original task prompts restrict answers to four letters.
Async graph execution awaits each ready node serially; the release does not execute all ready nodes as a concurrent batch.

candidates.integration_decision: Retain as a recent learned-communication reference, but defer the infer-only comparison because a trained task/model-specific topology is unavailable. Do not substitute an invented pruning rule.

venue_corrections.decision: Do not count toward ICLR/ICML/NeurIPS roster. Published ACL BibTeX is included for correcting the older preprint entry.
